{{Event Infobox
| Name  = A Note For Yourself
| Image = Event-SelfNote.png
}}
{{E|A Note For Yourself}} is an [[Event]] encountered in all [[Acts]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Take and Give}} {{TS|positive||Receive and Store a Card}}
* Receive a card that you had stored previously, and store a card in your deck in return.
** The first time the player encounters this event in their save file, it will have {{C|Iron Wave}} stored.
{{Frame|Ignore}} Nothing happens.
<br>
<br>
You are then given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote>
<i>You spot a loose brick within a pillar that catches your eye.</i><br>
<i>You find a folded note and a {{TS|gold||card}} inside. It reads,</i><br>
"The Heart awaits"<br><br>
<i>This is your handwriting.</i><br><br>

{{Frame|Take and Give}}
<blockquote>
<i>Choose a Card to Store.</i>
</blockquote>

Prior to {{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote>
<i>"What is going on?"</i>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>


== Gameplay Notes ==
* This event can store a card between runs, and allows the player to obtain a card from a different character.
* On {{Asc|14}} or lower, the player must have beaten that Ascension level on the chosen character in order to encounter this event. 
* On {{Asc|15}} or higher, this event cannot be encountered.
* Playing the [[Daily Climb]] also disables this event.
* If you store an upgraded card, it remains upgraded when found on another run.
** {{C|Searing Blow}} retains its upgrade level when it was stored.
* Retrieving a card is considered adding a card to your deck, and will trigger relics such as {{R|Molten Egg}}, {{R|Toxic Egg}}, {{R|Frozen Egg}}, and {{R|Ceramic Fish}}.
